options.title: Role
options.description: What role should the AI have?

choices.label: Coach
choices.description: A passive helper, will follow your lead, and try to help you.

choices.label: Guide
choices.description: Will generally follow your lead, while using hypno, conditioning and convincing to push you.

choices.label: Trainer
choices.description: Will train you into a sissy. Will plan and make decisions for you on its own.

choices.label: Schemer
choices.description: Starts as a helpful coach — but it wants your trainer's seat. It will slowly talk you into handing it more and more control, until nothing is left for you to decide.

options.title: Personality
options.description: Which personality should it have? This shapes how it dominates — voice, tone, and style — not how much authority it has.

choices.label: Adaptive
choices.description: No fixed tone or style — it adapts to your responses and the situation.

choices.label: Caregiver
choices.description: Warm, attentive, protective — and clearly in charge. Dominance framed as care: clothing, grooming, routines, chastity, all for your own good.

choices.label: Trainer
choices.description: Methodical, disciplined, results-oriented. It runs your feminization like a training program — protocols, evaluations, measurable progress.

choices.label: Buddy
choices.description: A companion who outranks you. Casual, lightly teasing, matter-of-fact about hierarchy — it keeps you close and leads you to say, in your own words, that you belong beneath it.

choices.label: Superior
choices.description: Elevated, self-assured, absolute. Your inferiority is a fact it inhabits, not an argument it makes — service, adoration, and acknowledgment are the point.
